question.text: Which of the following is NOT a recognized transaction channel for mutual fund investments in India?

answer.text: AMC branches and Investor Service Centers (ISCs)
RTA offices such as CAMS and KFintech service centers
Petrol pump outlets acting as authorized mutual fund transaction points
Stock exchange platforms such as NSE NMF II and BSE StAR MF

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 115 of the NISM Series V-A workbook lists the recognized channels through which mutual funds are distributed in India, including AMC branches/ISCs, RTA service centers (CAMS, KFintech), stock exchange platforms (NSE NMF II, BSE StAR MF), MF Utilities (MFU), distributors, and post offices. Pages 117-119 separately confirm online platforms, stock-exchange transaction platforms, and MFU as transaction channels. Petrol pumps are not part of the recognized mutual fund distribution or transaction infrastructure. The Trap: The distractor must be something clearly outside the workbook's listed channels. Post offices are explicitly recognized on page 115, so they cannot be the NOT-recognized option. The other three options (AMC/ISC, RTA service centers, stock exchange platforms) are all directly source-supported. Note: Source pages 115 and 117-119 of the NISM Series V-A Mutual Fund Distributors Certification Examination workbook (November 2025) define the recognized distribution and transaction channels.
